extra.final_summary: The data had two issues affecting the question: (1) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas, which was fixed by casting to numeric; (2) one row (row 10) had an impossible body mass of 4,000,000 grams, which was excluded as it violated the allowed range [2500, 6500] grams. Additionally, label variants in 'island' (Bisco → Biscoe, Torgerson → Torgersen) and 'sex' (MALE → male, FEMALE → female) were normalized to match the allowed values in the rules file. After these fixes, the average body mass by species was calculated: Adelie: 3848.91 g, Chinstrap: 3721.43 g, Gentoo: 5181.82 g.
